proposal: HSP-029: Establish a 24-Month Issuance Ramp to a 1.6% Target Rate Of NEAR Token Emissions
source_kind: NEAR governance forum, first post of the proposal thread (the proposal text)

quotes.text: Maximum annual issuance declines linearly from 2.5% to 1.6% over 24 months, applied per epoch at roughly 3.75 basis points per month
cap(t) = 2.5% - 0.9% x min(t, 24)/24 (minus and times signs transliterated to ASCII)
where t is months elapsed from activation, interpolated per epoch. Activation occurs one full quarter after ratification.

not_in_source: The ratification date. The scenario rows assume an activation month and say so.
